quest.track_quest.title: Start tracking a quest for a player
quest.track_quest.description: The `Track Quest Action` is an action that tracks a quest when triggered. Though quests are tracked automatically, this action can force a quest to be tracked. Start tacking a quest, so it displays in the player's quest tracker.
quest.locatable_objectives_path_stream.t: Unified automatic path stream to any tracked locatable objective
quest.locatable_objectives_path_stream.d: The `Locatable Objectives Path Stream` entry is a path stream that shows the path to each tracked locatable objective. When the player has a locatable objective, like `LocationObjective` or `InteractEntityObjective`, and the quest for the objective is tracked, a path stream will be displayed. This could be used to show a path to each locatable objective in a quest.
quest.location_objectives_path_stream.ti: A Path Stream to tracked Location Objectives
quest.location_objectives_path_stream.de: The `Location Objectives Path Stream` entry is a path stream that shows the path to each tracked location objective. When the player has a location objective, and the quest for the objective is tracked, a path stream will be displayed. This could be used to show a path to each location objective in a quest.
quest.objective_lines.title: Display all the current objectives
quest.objective_lines.description: The `ObjectiveLinesEntry` is a display that shows all the current objectives. This could be used to show a list of tracked objectives
quest.quest.title: A quest definition
quest.quest.description: The `Quest` entry is a collection of tasks that the player can complete. It is mainly for displaying the progress to a player. It is **not** necessary to use this entry for quests. It is just a visual novelty. The entry filters the audience based on if the quest is active. This could be used to show the progress of a quest to a player. Connect objectives to the quest to show a player what they need to do.
quest.quest.fields.activeCriteria.label: Active Criteria
quest.quest.fields.activeCriteria.help: When the criteria is met, it considers the quest to be active.
quest.quest.fields.completedCriteria.hel: When the criteria is met, it considers the quest to be completed.
quest.tracked_objective_audience.title: Filters an audience based on if they have a tracked objective
quest.tracked_objective_audience.descrip: The `Tracked Objective Audience` entry filters an audience based on if they have a tracked objective. It looks if the player has an objective showing from the quest that is being tracked. This could be used to show a boss bar or sidebar based on if a player has an objective showing.
quest.tracked_quest_audience.title: Filters an audience based on if they have a quest tracked
quest.tracked_quest_audience.description: The `Tracked Quest Audience` entry filters an audience based on if they have a quest tracked. If no quest is referenced, it will filter based on if any quest is tracked. This could be used to show a boss bar or sidebar based on if a player has a quest tracked.
quest.tracked_quest_audience.fields.ques: When not set, it will filter based on if any quest is tracked.
quest.quest_complete_event.title: Triggered when a quest is completed for a player
quest.quest_complete_event.description: The `Quest Complete Event` entry is triggered when a quest is completed for a player. When no quest is referenced, it will trigger for all quests. This could be used to show a title or notification to a player when a quest is completed.
When not set, it will trigger for all quests.
quest.quest_start_event.title: Triggered when a quest is started for a player
quest.quest_start_event.description: The `Quest Start Event` entry is triggered when a quest is started for a player. When no quest is referenced, it will trigger for all quests. This could be used to show a title or notification to a player when a quest is started.
quest.quest_start_event.fields.quest.hel: When not set, it will trigger for all quests.
quest.quest_status_update_event.title: Triggered when a quest status is updated for a player
quest.quest_status_update_event.descript: The `Quest Status Update Event` entry is triggered when a quest status is updated for a player. When no quest is referenced, it will trigger for all quests. This could be used to show a title or notification to a player when a quest status is updated.
quest.quest_status_update_event.fields.q: When not set, it will trigger for all quests.
quest.quest_status_update_event.fields.f: When not set, it will trigger for all statuses.
quest.quest_status_fact.title: The status of a specific quest
quest.quest_status_fact.description: The `QuestStatusFact` is a fact that returns the status of a specific quest. <fields.ReadonlyFactInfo /> | Status | Value | |--------|-------| | Inactive | 0 | | Active | 1 | | Active and Tracked | 2 | | Completed | -1 | :::warning The __completed__ status has a value of **-1**, this is to make it easy to query if the quest is active by `>= 1`. ::: This can be used to abstract the status of a quest. If a quest has multiple criteria, you can check for this fact instead of checking for each criterion.
quest.completable_objective.title: An objective that can show a completed stage
quest.completable_objective.description: The `Completable Objective` entry is an objective that can show a completed stage. It is shown to the player when the show criteria are met, regardless of if the completed criteria are met. This is useful when the quest has multiple objectives that can be completed in different orders. For example, the player needs to collect wheat, eggs, and milk to make a cake. The order in which the player collects the items does not matter. But you want to show the player which items they have collected.
quest.completable_objective.fields.showC: The criteria need to be met for the objective to be able to be shown.
quest.completable_objective.fields.compl: The criteria to display the objective as completed.
quest.countable_objective.title: An objective that can show a fact
quest.countable_objective.fields.count.h: The value that is being counted towards the target.
The target value to reach for completion.
quest.objective.title: An objective definition
quest.objective.description: The `Objective` entry is a tasks that the player can complete. It is mainly for displaying the progress to a player. It is **not** necessary to use this entry for objectives. It is just a visual novelty. The entry filters the audience based on if the objective is active. It will show the objective to the player if the criteria are met. This could be used to show the players what they need to do.
quest.break_block_objective.title: A break block objective definition
quest.break_block_objective.description: The `BreakBlockObjective` entry is a task that the player can complete by breaking a specific amount of blocks. This could be used to create objectives where players need to break certain blocks.
quest.break_block_objective.fields.block: The specific block type that needs to be broken. If not set, any block type will count.
quest.break_block_objective.fields.progr: Track the progress of the BreakBlockObjective using a fact and set its target value.
quest.breed_mob_objective.title: A breed mob objective definition
quest.breed_mob_objective.description: The `BreedMobObjective` entry is a task that the player can complete by breeding a specific amount of mobs. This could be used to create objectives where players need to breed certain mobs.
quest.breed_mob_objective.fields.mob.hel: The specific mob type that needs to be bred. If not set, any mob type will count.
quest.breed_mob_objective.fields.progres: Track the progress of the BreedMobObjective using a fact and set its target value.
quest.completable_location_objective.tit: A location objective that can show a completed stage
quest.completable_location_objective.fie: The criteria need to be met for the objective to be able to be shown.
The criteria to display the objective as completed.
quest.fish_objective.title: A fish objective definition
quest.fish_objective.description: The `FishObjective` entry is a task that the player can complete by fishing a specific amount of fish or item. This could be used to create objectives where players need to fish certain fish or item.
quest.fish_objective.fields.caught.label: Caught
quest.fish_objective.fields.caught.help: The specific fish or item type that needs to be fished. If not set, any fish or item type will count.
quest.fish_objective.fields.progressTrac: Track the progress of the FishObjective using a fact and set its target value.
quest.kill_entity_objective.title: A kill entity objective definition
quest.kill_entity_objective.description: The `KillEntityObjective` entry is a task that the player can complete by killing a specific amount of entities. This could be used to create objectives where players need to kill certain entities.
quest.kill_entity_objective.fields.entit: The specific entity type that needs to be killed. If not set, any entity type will count.
quest.kill_entity_objective.fields.progr: Track the progress of the KillEntityObjective using a fact and set its target value.
quest.location_objective.title: A location objective definition
quest.location_objective.description: The `LocationObjective` entry is a task that the player can complete by reaching a specific location. It is mainly for displaying the progress to a player. It is **not** necessary to use this entry for objectives. It is just a visual novelty. The entry filters the audience based on if the objective is active. It will show the objective to the player if the criteria are met. It allows path streams to be displayed to the target location. This could be used to guide the players to a specific location. Showing the players where they need to go with a path stream.
quest.place_block_objective.title: A place block objective definition
quest.place_block_objective.description: The `PlaceBlockObjective` entry is a task that the player can complete by placing a specific amount of blocks. This could be used to create objectives where players need to place certain blocks.
quest.place_block_objective.fields.block: The specific block type that needs to be placed. If not set, any block type will count.
quest.place_block_objective.fields.progr: Track the progress of the PlaceBlockObjective using a fact and set its target value.
quest.shear_entity_objective.title: A shear entity objective definition
quest.shear_entity_objective.description: The `ShearEntityObjective` entry is a task that the player can complete by shearing a specific amount of entities. This could be used to create objectives where players need to shear certain entities.
quest.shear_entity_objective.fields.enti: The specific entity type that needs to be sheared. If not set, any entity type will count.
quest.shear_entity_objective.fields.prog: Track the progress of the ShearEntityObjective using a fact and set its target value.
quest.smelt_objective.title: A smelt objective definition
quest.smelt_objective.description: Represents a task where the player completes an objective by smelting a specific material. Use this for quests that require players to smelt a specific number of items, like "Smelt 10 Iron Ingots" or "Cook 5 Fish".
quest.smelt_objective.fields.result.help: The item that is the end result of the smelt (e.g. IRON_INGOT)! If not set, any block type will count.
quest.smelt_objective.fields.progressTra: Track the progress of the SmeltObjective using a fact and set its target value.
quest.travel_objective.title: A travel distance objective definition
quest.travel_objective.description: Any ground movement that is not sprinting, sneaking, swimming, flying, or gliding.
quest.travel_objective.fields.movementTy: The movement types to track. If empty, any movement (walk, sprint, swim, fly, etc.) will count.
quest.travel_objective.fields.progressTr: Track the progress of the TravelObjective using a fact and set its target value.
